headline: Brazil Central Bank Keeps Selic Benchmark Interest Rate Unchanged at 13.75%
summary: Brazil's Central Bank Monetary Policy Committee unanimously decided to keep the Selic benchmark interest rate unchanged at 13.75% per year, citing rising uncertainties and inflation expectations above target.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions anchor monetary policy, influence domestic borrowing costs, and impact foreign exchange flows and equity valuations.

impacts.name: Brazil Selic Rate
impacts.why: Maintaining the benchmark policy rate directly affects short-term domestic borrowing costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The central bank held rates steady due to increasing recent uncertainties and inflation expectations remaining above the target.
